scope: D2 incremental source preparation only; all entries describe actual observed errors

errors.operation: First RemoteZip.extract for new scanned-PDF native source
errors.error: ValueError: relative target is not in the absolute project subpath
errors.effect: CRC-verified native bytes were already written; no database operation occurred
errors.fix: Resolved target to absolute path and verified existing size/CRC without a second download

errors.error: SyntaxError: unterminated string literal due to PowerShell interpreting a Markdown backtick
errors.effect: No metric approval record was written by the failed one-liner
errors.fix: Used a Python helper file with literal source; recorded explicit user attestation separately
Changed encoding name to utf-8-sig; rerun succeeded

errors.error: FileNotFoundError: LibreOffice soffice.exe was not found on PATH
errors.fix: Used installed Microsoft Word read-only native export, then Poppler PNG rendering and visual inspection of all four final pages

errors.operation: D2 command recorder with a relative --directory on three successful child commands
errors.error: ValueError during output.relative_to(ROOT) because directory remained relative
errors.effect: DOCX authoring, manifest update and Word rendering child commands succeeded; .txt output existed, recorder metadata failed
errors.fix: Used an absolute project-local recording directory; root also corrected the recorder

errors.error: ValueError: Gold quote for rag-25 is not an exact substring of actual parsed source
errors.cause: Two actual same-column OCR blocks were incorrectly represented as contiguous page text while four-column OCR interleaves neighbouring lines
errors.fix: Preserved the actual continuous recorded span and separately stored both real text blocks with physical-page-2 boxes; reading-order limitation remains explicit

errors.operation: RAG30 review CSV generation after successful dataset write
errors.cause: CSV field slice included the computed review-status field among source item fields
errors.fix: Corrected source-field slice; full preparation rerun passed

visual_layout_correction: First Word render exposed decorative blue Title borders inherited from the bundled default template. Removed paragraph borders, rerendered and inspected all final pages. No body definitions were changed.
